trajectory_messages.content:
Implement enhancements to the `ArchivedTimelineV1` class to support more flexible loading of historical commit data from archive log files. Add constructors and methods to filter by time range, lifecycle state, and specific log files, ensuring state-aware retrieval of instant details.

*   Update `ArchivedTimelineV1` class:
    *   Implement a constructor `ArchivedTimelineV1(HoodieTableMetaClient metaClient, String startTs, String endTs)` to load only COMPLETED instants within the closed range [startTs, endTs].
    *   Implement a constructor `ArchivedTimelineV1(HoodieTableMetaClient metaClient, String startTs, String endTs, Option<HoodieInstant.State> state)` to load instants of a specified state within [startTs, endTs].
    *   Implement a constructor `ArchivedTimelineV1(HoodieTableMetaClient metaClient, Set<String> logFiles)` to load only COMPLETED instants from specified archive log files.
    *   Implement a constructor `ArchivedTimelineV1(HoodieTableMetaClient metaClient, Set<String> logFiles, Option<HoodieInstant.State> state)` to load instants of a specified state from specified log files.
    *   Ensure `getInstantDetails(HoodieInstant instant)` retrieves state-specific details independently, returning an empty `Optional` if the (timestamp, state) combination was not loaded.
    *   Ensure CLEAN and ROLLBACK action types only load COMPLETED metadata; `getInstantDetails` must return empty for REQUESTED or INFLIGHT states.
    *   Ensure REPLACE_COMMIT action type does not load INFLIGHT metadata; handle REQUESTED and COMPLETED states separately.
    *   Implement the no-argument constructor `ArchivedTimelineV1(HoodieTableMetaClient metaClient)` to load all instants without loading byte details into memory.

*   Add `ClosedClosedTimeRangeFilter` inner class to `HoodieArchivedTimeline`:
    *   Implement `ClosedClosedTimeRangeFilter(String startTs, String endTs)` to provide a closed-closed range check.
    *   Implement `boolean isInRange(String instantTime)` and `boolean isInRange(HoodieInstant instant)` methods.

*   Implement additional methods:
    *   `void loadCompactionDetailsInMemory(String ts)` to load compaction plan bytes for the INFLIGHT state of a compaction instant.
    *   `void loadInstantDetailsInMemory(String startTs, String endTs)` to load details for all available states of all action types within [startTs, endTs], excluding REPLACE_COMMIT inflight and CLEAN/ROLLBACK requested/inflight states.

## Summary

I enhanced `ArchivedTimelineV1` to support state-aware loading of historical commit data. The verification test suite (`TestArchivedTimelineV1`, 19 tests) passes, along with regression tests for consumers of `getInstantDetails`.

### Core change: state-aware detail storage
The key insight from the tests is that `getInstantDetails(instant)` must retrieve details for the specific `(timestamp, state)` combination, not just by timestamp. I changed `readCommits` (and the internal instant map) to be keyed by `instantTime + "_" + state.name()`, so all three states of the same instant time are tracked independently.

### Files changed

**`HoodieArchivedTimeline.java`** — Added the `ClosedClosedTimeRangeFilter` inner class (range `[startTs, endTs]`) backed by `InstantComparison.isInClosedRange`, with both `isInRange(String)` and `isInRange(HoodieInstant)`.

**`ArchivedTimelineLoader.java`** — Added an overloaded `loadInstants(...)` accepting a nullable `Set<String> logFilePaths` as a `default` method (so `ArchivedTimelineLoaderV2` is unaffected).

**`ArchivedTimelineLoaderV1.java`** — Implemented the log-file overload; when `logFilePaths` is provided, the globbed archive entries are filtered to those matching paths before reading.

**`ArchivedTimelineV1.java`** — The main rework:
- Added constructors: `(metaClient, startTs, endTs)` → COMPLETED-only in `[startTs, endTs]`; `(metaClient, startTs, endTs, Option<State>)`; `(metaClient, Set<String> logFiles)` → COMPLETED-only; `(metaClient, Set<String> logFiles, Option<State>)`. The no-arg constructor still loads all instants (all states) without byte details.
- `getInstantDetails` now looks up by the composite `(ts, state)` key, returning empty for uncombined pairs.
- State-aware `getMetadataKey(action, state)`: CLEAN/ROLLBACK load metadata only for COMPLETED; REPLACE_COMMIT handles REQUESTED (`hoodieRequestedReplaceMetadata`) and COMPLETED (`hoodieReplaceCommitMetadata`) but never INFLIGHT.
- Since the V1 loader only uses the time filter for file-skipping, I apply the range check per-record via a wrapped filter, so range/startTs constructors filter precisely.
- `loadCompactionDetailsInMemory(String ts)` now loads the INFLIGHT compaction plan for that single instant (using a closed-closed filter, fixing the prior exclusive-range that would have loaded nothing for a single ts).
- `loadInstantDetailsInMemory(startTs, endTs)` loads all states of all actions in `[startTs, endTs]`, with the exclusions handled automatically by the state-aware metadata resolution.

One thing worth flagging: the existing `ArchivedTimelineV1(metaClient, startTs)` constructor previously did not apply the time bound per-record (it relied only on file-skipping). The new tests require precise `ts >= startTs` filtering, so my per-record filtering changes that constructor's behavior to match its documented contract ("loads completed instants from startTs inclusive").
